rules.likely_broken: 20+ ratings, 50%+ one-star, under 60% rendered or no telemetry
rules.first_run_friction: 50%+ one-star but 60%+ of users render the game eventually
rules.recovered: verdict is no longer BROKEN or LIKELY_BROKEN on the current release
